steps.summary: Signed into Odoo 17 with admin/admin, navigated to Contacts, created a new contact named 'fwod33-n3 Bench Customer' with City set to 'Benchville', and saved it. The record was created (id=44) and the form displays the name as "fwod33-n3 Bench Customer" and the city as "Benchville", confirming both values were saved correctly.

Created Quotation S00025 for customer 'fwod33-n3 Bench Customer' (city Benchville) with a single order line: Product [FURN_8888] Office Lamp, Quantity 3, Unit Price £40.00 (auto-filled), Untaxed Amount £120.00 (computed as 3×40). The quotation was saved and verified on the form view.

Opened Quotation S00025 for customer 'fwod33-n3 Bench Customer' (existing line: [FURN_8888] Office Lamp qty 3). Added a second order line with product [FURN_7777] Office Chair, quantity 2, unit price £70.00 (auto-filled), line subtotal £140.00. Saved the quotation. The new total Untaxed Amount is £260.00 (120.00 + 140.00).

On Quotation S00025 (customer 'fwod33-n3 Bench Customer'), changed the first line '[FURN_8888] Office Lamp' quantity from 3 to 5. The first line's new subtotal is £200.00 (5×£40.00). The new total Untaxed Amount is £340.00 (£200.00 + £140.00 from Office Chair qty 2). Saved the quotation. The order has not been confirmed.

Confirmed Quotation S00025 (customer 'fwod33-n3 Bench Customer') into a Sales Order. The status bar displays "Sales Order" as the active/checked status (alongside "Quotation Sent" and "Quotation" as unchecked options). The order reference is S00025.

Cancelled Sales Order S00025 (customer 'fwod33-n3 Bench Customer'). Accepted the confirmation dialog. The status bar now displays "Cancelled" as the active status (alongside "Sales Order", "Quotation Sent", and "Quotation" as unchecked options).
